items.title: evaluate_probe per-class empty check uses tuple instead of count
items.criterion: In evaluate_probe, `total` is the element count (`y_filtered.shape[0]` or `.size`), so a mapped class absent from y gets a score of 0 instead of a metric over empty arrays. A test with an idx_to_class entry missing from y asserts that score.

items.title: Flatten regression predictions in evaluate_probe
items.criterion: Regression outputs are squeezed to shape [N] (e.g. `outputs.data.squeeze(1)`), so y_pred is 1-D and metrics such as pearson return a scalar. A regression evaluate_probe test checks the scalar score.

items.title: create_tensors crashes on regression in label-stats printing
items.criterion: The final per-label frequency printing (which uses idx2label) runs only for classification, or numeric stats are printed for regression. create_tensors with task_type='regression' then runs without NameError/UnboundLocalError, and a test covers it.

items.title: Replace removed np.int with np.int64
items.criterion: All uses of `np.int` in create_tensors and the tests are replaced with np.int64 or int, so the code runs on NumPy >= 1.24.

items.title: Keep batch dimension when squeezing regression training outputs
items.criterion: _train_probe uses `outputs.squeeze(-1)` (or `.view(-1)`) instead of `.squeeze()`, so a final batch of size 1 keeps shape (1,) against its labels.

items.title: Multiclass support for f1 and accuracy_and_f1 metrics
items.criterion: f1 and accuracy_and_f1 pass an `average` setting (a parameter or an automatic macro default for >2 classes), so multiclass inputs no longer raise. accuracy_and_f1 reuses f1, and tests cover binary and multiclass inputs.

items.title: Deterministic index assignment in tok2idx
items.criterion: tok2idx enumerates tokens in a stable order (sorted or first-seen) instead of raw set iteration, so mappings are identical across processes. Tests check the exact mappings.

items.title: visualize_activations: avoid ZeroDivisionError for all-zero activations
items.criterion: When the max absolute score is 0, opacity is 0 (or the limit is set to 1) instead of dividing by zero. Empty input is either handled or rejected explicitly.

items.title: visualize_activations score misalignment with long or spaced tokens
items.criterion: Line breaking groups the token list directly, with at least one token per line and no empty lines. Scores therefore stay 1:1 with tokens when a token exceeds char_limit, and tokens with spaces are rejected or handled.

items.title: RTL rendering must keep scores attached to correct tokens
items.criterion: Under text_direction='rtl', token-score pairs are reversed together, or scores are indexed by logical position, so each word gets its own score. A test with distinct per-token scores checks this.

items.title: get_top_words: handle constant neuron and zero max score
items.criterion: When std == 0 or max_score == 0 (and for an empty corpus), get_top_words returns an empty list or defined scores instead of producing NaN or raising ZeroDivisionError. Tests cover these cases.

items.title: Validate token/activation alignment in get_top_words
items.criterion: get_top_words raises ValueError when sentence counts or per-sentence token counts differ between tokens['source'] and activations, or when the neuron index is out of range. Mismatch tests are added.

items.title: Validate tokens/activations structure in create_tensors
items.criterion: create_tensors checks up front that source/target sentence and token counts match and that each activations[i].shape[0] equals the sentence length. It raises ValueError otherwise, and tests cover this.

items.title: Implement save_probe and load_probe
items.criterion: save_probe serializes the probe state_dict, its architecture metadata (input size, num classes) and mappings, e.g. with torch.save. load_probe reconstructs the probe, using map_location. A round-trip test checks predictions; at minimum the stubs must raise NotImplementedError instead of silently passing.

items.title: balance_multi_class_data: feasible per-class counts
items.criterion: num_required_instances is validated to be in (0, total], and each per-class target is capped at the class count. Exact allocation is optional. RandomUnderSampler never gets a request above a class size, and a test covers this.

items.title: Fix epoch loss denominator in _train_probe
items.criterion: The reported epoch loss either averages batch means over the number of batches or weights each batch loss by its size before dividing by num_tokens.

items.title: Coerce probe training/eval inputs to correct dtypes
items.criterion: Before building tensors, X is cast to float32 (including float16/float64 activations). y is cast to int64 for classification and float32 for regression. Tests train on non-float32 inputs.

items.title: Run evaluate_probe under no_grad and eval mode
items.criterion: evaluate_probe calls probe.eval() (optionally restoring the previous mode afterwards) and wraps forward passes in torch.no_grad().

items.title: compute_score raises on unknown metric
items.criterion: compute_score raises ValueError listing the supported metrics for an unknown name, instead of returning None. A test covers this.

items.title: Clip correlations to keep a valid distance matrix
items.criterion: create_correlation_clusters clips corr to [-1, 1] (or dissimilarity to >= 0), sets the dissimilarity diagonal to exactly 0 and keeps it symmetric before squareform/linkage.

items.title: Replace removed seaborn factorplot in plot_accuracies_per_tag
items.criterion: plot_accuracies_per_tag draws on the created axes with sns.barplot(ax=ax, ...) instead of sns.factorplot, so it works with current seaborn and no extra figure is created.

items.title: plot_accuracies_per_tag: fix dead kwargs check and missing __OVERALL__
items.criterion: `if kwargs is None` becomes `if not kwargs`, with a clear error. Removing '__OVERALL__' no longer raises when the key is absent, or a clear error is raised instead.

items.title: Plotting functions return figures and use correct palette length
items.criterion: plot_distributedness passes ax to barplot and returns fig. plot_accuracies creates a fig, uses a colors list matching the 15 bars, drops the unused `exps`, and returns fig.

items.title: Ablation docstrings and tests: copy, not view
items.criterion: The filter_activations_keep_neurons, filter_activations_remove_neurons and keep_specific_neurons docstrings say a copy is returned. The '*_view' tests assert that mutating the result leaves the original X unchanged.

items.title: Validate filter_activations_by_layers arguments
items.criterion: ValueError is raised for empty layers_to_keep, layers outside [0, num_layers), and feature counts not divisible by num_layers (or 2*num_layers). The mode is checked without assert, the 'forward layer 0/1' Notes typo is fixed, and tests cover each error.

items.title: Add tests for clustering module
items.criterion: New tests/interpretation/test_clustering.py covers create_correlation_clusters (correlated/anticorrelated pairs, use_abs_correlation) and extract_independent_neurons / scikit_extract_independent_neurons.

items.title: Port or remove broken examples/train_classifier.py
items.criterion: The example no longer imports the nonexistent aux_classifier package. It either uses neurox.data/neurox.interpretation APIs and runs with --help, or it is deleted. The argparse default+required conflict is removed.

items.title: Relax exact dependency pins in install_requires
items.criterion: setup.cfg install_requires uses compatible lower bounds or ranges instead of `==` pins. Exact pins remain only in a dev lock file, if anywhere.

items.title: CI installs package with dev extras instead of requirements.txt
items.criterion: The test workflow runs `pip install '.[dev]'`, setup.cfg defines a dev extra with the test/format tooling, and the redundant requirements.txt and conda-environment.yml are removed.

items.title: Update CI Python matrix to runnable versions
items.criterion: Python 3.6 no longer runs on ubuntu-latest: it moves to a separate ubuntu-20.04 workflow or is dropped. The main matrix uses quoted, available versions, and actions are bumped where practical.

items.title: Align python_requires and install docs with supported versions
items.criterion: setup.cfg python_requires/classifiers, README and installation.rst state the supported Python range matching CI. README describes venv plus `pip install -e .` installation instead of sys.path hacks and conda.

items.title: Add pandas to install requirements
items.criterion: pandas is listed in setup.cfg install_requires (and requirements.txt if kept), so neurox.analysis.plotting imports in a clean install.

items.title: Support noncontiguous class labels in _train_probe
items.criterion: num_classes is derived from max label + 1, or labels are validated/remapped, so labels like [1, 2] do not cause CrossEntropyLoss out-of-bounds errors. A test with noncontiguous labels is added.

items.title: Validate X/y length match in probe training
items.criterion: _train_probe raises ValueError when X.shape[0] != len(y) (and for empty X), with a test.

items.title: Fix L2 penalty: squared norm or NaN-safe gradient
items.criterion: l2_penalty returns the sum of squared weights or adds an epsilon inside the sqrt, so the gradient at all-zero weights is finite. The incorrect 'no difference' docstring note is fixed, and test_l2_penalty is updated.

items.title: Remove deprecated torch Variable wrappers
items.criterion: _train_probe and evaluate_probe no longer use torch.autograd.Variable and operate on tensors directly.

items.title: Return neuron unions in sorted order
items.criterion: get_top_neurons, get_bottom_neurons and get_top_neurons_hard_threshold return sorted arrays instead of `list(set)` order, and tests assert the ordering.

items.title: Hard-threshold docstring matches max/fraction formula and validates fraction
items.criterion: The get_top_neurons_hard_threshold docstring describes the implemented `weight > max / fraction` rule (or code and docs are changed consistently), and fraction <= 0 raises ValueError.

items.title: Fix flaky return_predictions test assertion
items.criterion: test_evaluate_probe_with_return_predictions drops assertNotEqual against random labels. It asserts p[2] == (p[1] == y_true[i]) for each prediction and seeds the RNGs.

items.title: Validate task_specific_tag exists in label2idx
items.criterion: When mappings are supplied for classification, create_tensors checks that task_specific_tag is in label2idx and raises a descriptive ValueError, with a test.

items.title: Reproducible balancing via random_state
items.criterion: balance_binary_class_data and balance_multi_class_data accept a random_state that is passed to RandomUnderSampler.

items.title: Replace deprecated tqdm_notebook import
items.criterion: get_progress_bar uses `tqdm.notebook.tqdm` (or tqdm.auto) instead of tqdm_notebook, and the fake-jupyter test is updated.

items.title: scikit_extract_independent_neurons: handle NaN distances from constant neurons
items.criterion: Correlation distances from pdist have NaN replaced (e.g. nan_to_num) before linkage, so dead neurons do not crash. The docstring no longer claims scikit-learn use or identical results.

items.title: Document extract_independent_neurons tuple return
items.criterion: The extract_independent_neurons docstring Returns section documents both independent_neurons and clusters.

items.title: Seeded representative selection in independent-neuron extraction
items.criterion: extract_independent_neurons and scikit_extract_independent_neurons accept a random_state/Generator for representative choice. A test shows that equal seeds give equal output.

items.title: Vectorize probeless mean-vector computation
items.criterion: _get_mean_vectors computes per-label means with np.unique plus boolean masking instead of a per-row Python loop. Unused rankings_per_label is removed, and `np.abs(np.subtract(qz, qz))` becomes np.zeros_like.

items.title: Add tests for probeless module
items.criterion: New tests/interpretation/test_probeless.py checks get_neuron_ordering, get_neuron_ordering_for_tag and get_neuron_ordering_for_all_tags on synthetic data where a known neuron ranks first, and that orderings are permutations.

items.title: Validate probeless inputs and missing tags
items.criterion: Probeless functions raise descriptive ValueError for a tag absent from label2idx or y_train, misaligned or non-1D y, non-2D X, or fewer than two classes.

items.title: Deprecation warning for keep_specific_neurons
items.criterion: keep_specific_neurons emits a DeprecationWarning and delegates to filter_activations_keep_neurons.

items.title: Handle filter_fn None or unknown string in visualize_activations
items.criterion: filter_fn=None leaves activations unchanged, and an unrecognized string raises ValueError instead of a TypeError from calling None/str.

items.title: Remove stray root __init__.py and exclude non-package dirs
items.criterion: The repository-root __init__.py is deleted, and package discovery excludes examples/docs.

items.title: Remove stray import json in metrics.py
items.criterion: The unused mid-module `import json` is removed from metrics.py.

items.title: Fix documentation build script
items.criterion: The docs script (moved to scripts/) has a correct sphinx-apidoc invocation and no unconditional macOS `open`. Docs dependencies are declared (docs/requirements.txt), and a docs/conf.py or readthedocs config exists.

items.title: Add min_threshold argument to get_top_words
items.criterion: get_top_words accepts min_threshold (default 0.1) replacing the hard-coded constant, and raises ValueError if both num_tokens and min_threshold are given. A test covers the exception.

items.title: Configurable activation dtype in extraction and writers
items.criterion: transformers_extractor functions and the CLI accept dtype (float16/float32, default float32), which is used for the hidden-state arrays. ActivationsWriter and the loader honor the dtype, with tests.

items.title: Fix context-sensitive subword tokenization in transformers extractor
items.criterion: Each word is tokenized with surrounding dummy context (e.g. 'a X a'), and the added tokens are stripped by position, so token counts match regardless of position. Tests cover varying tokenizations of the same word.

items.title: Optionally include special tokens in extracted representations
items.criterion: extract_sentence_representations takes include_special_tokens. When true, it returns activations and detokenized entries for tokenizer special tokens ([CLS], [SEP]), with tests and a documented docstring.

items.title: Add control task module
items.criterion: A new neurox/data/control_task.py builds control-task (random label assignment per word type) datasets, and tests are in tests/data/test_control_task.py.

items.title: Add IoU-based neuron ranking probe
items.criterion: A new neurox/interpretation/iou_probe.get_neuron_ordering thresholds small activations and ranks neurons by average_precision_score in descending order. A test with a perfectly correlated neuron is included.

items.title: Add Gaussian probe for neuron ranking
items.criterion: A new neurox/interpretation/gaussian_probe.py implements a GaussianProbe with per-class mean/covariance estimation and neuron selection, plus tests.

items.title: Fix deprecated collections.Callable in annotate.py
items.criterion: annotate.py uses collections.abc.Callable for the binary_filter check, so it works on Python 3.10+. Docstrings containing backslashes are raw strings.

items.title: Add code-formatting check workflow and format script
items.criterion: A GitHub workflow runs `ufmt check` on neurox and tests, scripts/format_code.sh formats them, and CONTRIBUTING documents its use.

items.title: Add pytest/coverage test runner script
items.criterion: scripts/run_tests.sh runs pytest with coverage from the repo root, .coveragerc shows missing lines, and CONTRIBUTING documents the dev setup (`pip install -e '.[dev]'`).

items.title: Version management with bumpversion
items.criterion: .bumpversion.cfg keeps the version in sync across setup.cfg and docs/conf.py, and CONTRIBUTING documents bump2version usage.

items.title: Remove debug prints and dead guard in create_tensors
items.criterion: `print(idx)`, `print(list(example_set)[:20])`, the unused example_set and the odd `if idx < num_tokens` guard are removed from create_tensors, along with the debug print in the balancing helper.

items.title: Reject balance_data for regression in create_tensors
items.criterion: create_tensors raises ValueError when balance_data=True with task_type='regression'.

items.title: Validate source_tokens length when returning predictions
items.criterion: With return_predictions, evaluate_probe raises ValueError if the flattened source_tokens length differs from X rows, instead of a mid-loop StopIteration or silently ignoring extra tokens.

items.title: evaluate_probe uses the probe's existing device
items.criterion: evaluate_probe infers the probe's current device and moves only the input batches, rather than moving the model to CUDA just because CUDA is available.

items.title: Validate probe training hyperparameters
items.criterion: _train_probe rejects nonpositive batch_size/epochs/learning rate, negative lambda penalties and NaN inputs with ValueError.

items.title: Boundary behavior for get_top/bottom_neurons percentage
items.criterion: percentage outside [0, 1] raises ValueError. percentage 0 returns no neurons, and all-zero class weights are handled deterministically, with tests.

items.title: get_random_neurons strict comparison and seeding
items.criterion: get_random_neurons uses a strict comparison so probability 0 selects nothing, validates the probability range, and accepts a random_state.

items.title: Validate batch_generator inputs
items.criterion: batch_generator raises on X/y length mismatch and on non-positive or non-integer batch_size, preventing the batch_size=0 infinite loop. Tests are added.

items.title: Fix test_linear_probe_forward to test forward pass
items.criterion: The test passes a valid (batch, 50) tensor to a real or properly mocked probe, and asserts that the forward call happens and the output shape is (batch, 5).

items.title: Text drawn once, not darken times, in visualize_activations
items.criterion: The text-drawing loop is moved outside the `for _ in range(darken)` loop, and the mutable default colors list becomes a tuple.

items.title: Explicit validation of visualize_activations parameters
items.criterion: Asserts are replaced with ValueError/TypeError checks for two colors, positive char_limit/font_size, non-negative integer darken and finite scores, with tests.

items.title: Handle degenerate inputs in clustering functions
items.criterion: The clustering functions validate 2-D finite input, return a single cluster for one neuron, and raise clear errors for empty or too-small matrices.

items.title: Pass linkage method through extract_independent_neurons
items.criterion: extract_independent_neurons accepts a `method` parameter and forwards it to create_correlation_clusters.

items.title: Fix multi-digit layer parsing in train_classifier example
items.criterion: The forward/backward pairing check uses `l[1:]` instead of `l[1]`, so layers such as f10/b10 validate correctly.

items.title: Fix evaluate_probe docstring parameter name
items.criterion: The evaluate_probe docstring documents `metric` (not `metrics`) and lists the valid values.

items.title: Fix get_top_neurons docstring order and typo
items.criterion: The get_top_neurons docstring says the selection is descending and fixes the 'compcomplete' typo.

items.title: Fix get_top_words docstring
items.criterion: The get_top_words docstring correctly describes the neuron index and the returned list of (token, score) tuples, with no stale 'relative to X' or top_neurons naming.
